timeline.note: C 的启动有条件：其他三名接球手都没有空位。由家长先选择演示情形；满足条件的分支示范等待 2 秒后跑完路线，另一个分支仅保留已知站位。2 秒、总时长 10 秒及其他球员同时起跑均为教学设置，不是比赛规则或完整时序。

en.timeline.note: C releases conditionally: the other three receivers are covered. Choose a situation first. The release branch waits two teaching seconds; the other branch only shows the known position. Ten seconds total, wait lengths and other players starting together are illustrative, not game rules or a complete timing sequence.
en.notes.0: This shows offensive routes without simulating defenders. Creating space is the play’s intent, not a guaranteed outcome.
en.notes.1: The cues and questions are teaching adaptations. Agree on crossing order before practicing on the field.
en.notes.2: Relative positions follow source page 7. Short connections approximate parts hidden beneath markers; they are not extra actions or measured yards.

en.players.C.label.description: Run forward, then break diagonally toward the right sideline.
en.players.C.label.note: Name follows the official NFL FLAG explanation (0:34–0:55); direction and geometry retain the supplied diagram on page 7.
en.players.C.coaching.cooperation: Join on a Corner if the other receivers are covered.
en.players.C.coaching.timing: Release if all three other receivers are covered. Choose the situation before playing. The two-second wait is a teaching setting.
en.players.C.motion.prompt: Choose a teaching situation first: C releases if all three other receivers are covered. This animation does not judge the defense.
en.players.C.motion.options.released.title: All three receivers covered: C joins

en.players.X.label.description: Run forward a short distance, then cut diagonally toward the middle.
en.players.X.label.note: Name follows the official NFL FLAG explanation (0:34–0:55); direction and geometry retain the supplied diagram on page 7.
en.players.X.coaching.cooperation: Run a Post toward the middle, working with Z on the other side.
en.players.X.coaching.timing: No exact start order is specified for this player. Starting at zero is a teaching setting.
en.players.Y.label.description: Start behind Q, run diagonally forward-left, then break toward the left side.
en.players.Y.label.note: Name follows the official NFL FLAG explanation (0:34–0:55); direction and geometry retain the supplied diagram on page 7.
en.players.Y.coaching.cooperation: Break out from the backfield to offer a different direction from X and Z.
en.players.Y.coaching.timing: No exact start order is specified for this player. Starting at zero is a teaching setting.
en.players.Z.label.description: Run forward a short distance, then cut diagonally toward the middle.
en.players.Z.label.note: Name follows the official NFL FLAG explanation (0:34–0:55); direction and geometry retain the supplied diagram on page 7.
en.players.Z.coaching.cooperation: Run a Post toward the middle, giving Q another option alongside X.
en.players.Z.coaching.timing: No exact start order is specified for this player. Starting at zero is a teaching setting.
en.keyframes.start.label: Line up · Choose a situation
en.keyframes.start.cue: Choose the situation first. Find Q, C, X, Y and Z. X and Z cut inside while Y breaks wide. C joins only if the other three receivers are covered.
en.keyframes.spread.label: Follow the selected situation
en.keyframes.spread.cue: C’s movement depends on the selected situation. X and Z cut inside while Y breaks wide. C joins only if the other three receivers are covered.
en.keyframes.middle.label: Pause · See the teamwork
en.keyframes.middle.cue: Pause and compare teammates’ routes. Who can offer another option if all three receivers are covered?
en.keyframes.end.label: Recall · Explain it
